hero.title: Jupiter The Warlock
hero.subtitle: Indie game developer and designer
hero.slogan: Kill the old self. Become a new human.

meta.title: Jupiter The Warlock — Indie Game Developer and Designer
meta.description: Games, open-source projects, and development notes by Jupiter The Warlock.

orbital-throw.title: Bet You Can’t Out-Throw Me!
orbital-throw.description: An arcade game where you anchor to asteroids to spin up and accelerate your spaceship. Made at the Guangzhou site of CiGA Game Jam 2026.

nest-of-rectangles.title: Nest of Rectangles + Nest of Fractals + Tomb of Rectangles + Cocoon + Skybox
nest-of-rectangles.description: Once you step into the Nest of Rectangles, it will no longer be just a nest of rectangles.

yeshit-rhapsody.title: YeShit Rhapsody
yeshit-rhapsody.description: In the final years of the Eastern Han dynasty, war and turmoil leave people starving. Three desperate people flee into the mountains and start eating shit.

reluctant-salted-fish.title: The Reluctant Salted Fish
reluctant-salted-fish.description: A Global Game Jam 2024 entry, voted fourth at the Guangzhou Gongke jam site.

king-of-petroleum.title: King of Petroleum
king-of-petroleum.description: A Global Game Jam 2025 entry for 2–4 local players. Controllers only.

godot-game-dev-skill.title: godot-game-dev-skill
godot-game-dev-skill.description: Portable Godot game development knowledge skill for AI coding agents

game-design-skill.title: game-design-skill
game-design-skill.description: Source-grounded game design methodology distilled from Claude-Code-Game-Studios for Claude Code and Codex.

jthewl-skills.title: jthewl-skills
jthewl-skills.description: Jupiter The Warlock’s personal Agent Skills Marketplace.

ai-game-music.title: Making a Balatro-Like Game Soundtrack with AI, Starting from Zero
ai-game-music.description: I have always envied game music you can recognize immediately. Before any visuals appear, the first few notes tell anyone who has played it which game it is.

ai-native-game.title: AI-Native Games Don’t Mean Letting AI Take Over the World
ai-native-game.description: I increasingly feel that many discussions of AI-native games start by approaching the problem from the wrong angle.
